pages.title: Finding Rubracium
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 0 to 30. Veins target up to 6 blocks, with 7 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 3.

pages.title: Working Rubracium
pages.text: Smelt Rubracium Ore or Rubracium Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.
